mūtuor

mūtuor, mūtuārī, mūtuātus sum

borrow (money)

In this lexicon

  • borrow

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Att. 7.3.11: ā Caeliō mūtuābimur, we’ll borrow from Caelius; Cic. Att. 15.15.3: cōgor mūtuārī, I am forced to borrow

Examples

  • 'solvāmus' inquis. age, ā Caeliō mūtuābimur.

    ‘Let’s pay,’ you say. All right, we’ll borrow from Caelius.Cic. Att. 7.3.11
